notablePrerequisites: Everflowing Chalice has at least five charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Staff of Domination and Basalt Monolith, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities and/or untap any artifact(s) you control.
